name: @edenapp/sdk
description: Eden Desktop Environment SDK - Build Electron-based desktop environments with modular app support

scripts.build: pnpm run tokens:build && pnpm run css:build && pnpm run codegen && pnpm run build:main && pnpm run bundle:app-frame && pnpm run bundle:app-runtime && pnpm run build:keyboard-ui && pnpm run build:apps && pnpm run copy-assets
scripts.css:build: npx lightningcss --bundle --minify --targets 'chrome 132' edencss/eden.css -o dist/edencss/eden.css && npx lightningcss --bundle --minify --targets 'chrome 132' edencss/tokens.css -o dist/edencss/eden-tokens.css
scripts.dev:prepare: pnpm run tokens:build && pnpm run css:build && pnpm run codegen && pnpm run build:main && pnpm run bundle:app-frame && pnpm run bundle:app-runtime && pnpm run build:apps && pnpm run copy-assets && eden-build seed -c eden.dev.config.json -o dist
scripts.tokens:build: cd edencss && npx style-dictionary build --config style-dictionary.config.mjs && cd .. && pnpm exec biome format --write edencss/tokens.css
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:integration:node
scripts.pretest:integration:electron: pnpm run build:electron-test-dependencies && pnpm run build:main && pnpm run bundle:app-runtime && pnpm run copy-assets && pnpm --dir apps/com/eden/pdf-viewer run build

author: Dariusz Majnert
